Internet Archive services were intermittently offline; some captures of Knesset plenum protocols could not be retrieved. Protocols obtained: 13th Knesset 1994–95 (27 sittings), 14th Knesset 1996–99 (29), 15th Knesset 1999–2002 (24).

Knesset record for tallies and readings was taken from the NYU Faculty Digital Archive mirror for 2 Jan 1996, 14 Feb 1996, 21 Feb 1996, 16 Jul 1996, 28 Oct 1996 and 18 Mar 1998, and from Internet Archive captures of fs.knesset.gov.il protocols for 2 Mar 1998, 18 Dec 2000, 13 Jun 2001 and 22 Jul 2002. The NYU mirror holds no sittings after Jan 1999 and none for 26/28 Feb 1996, 30 Oct 1996 or 4 Jan 1999.
Government composition was taken from Wikipedia articles (English for the 26th, 27th and 30th governments; Hebrew for the 28th and 29th) because the Knesset site was unreachable.
Press used: Jerusalem Post of 19 Dec 2000 as quoted by the Jewish Virtual Library (seq 61 tally, corroborating the Knesset record) and Globes of 2 Mar 1998 (seq 51 bill's government approval).

Final-vote tallies not found for seq 42, 45, 48, 54, 58, 64, 67 and 70; first-reading dates not found for seq 39, 45, 54, 67 and 70. For seq 58, 64 and 73 'expedited' is coded Yes on the span from the bill's gazette publication to the final vote (26, 28 and 23 days), with the first-reading date unverified; for seq 48 it is coded No on the first-reading debate date although that reading's vote was deferred to an unidentified later sitting.

Seq 67: the sheet's text link (15_lsr_300419.pdf) is Basic Law: The Knesset (Amendment No. 34); the President amendment is 15_lsr_300418.pdf. Both come from the same bill, passed the same day and share the gazette page, and were coded as one enactment.

Seq 39, 45, 54 and 61 were coded from the archived Nevo consolidated text of the 1992 Government law, as the gazette PDFs of those amendments were not located; the sheet's own link for those rows is the same Nevo page.
